answer.text: No. The manual says not to ride the motorcycle if the ABS lamp stays on continuously above 5 km/h.
Take the motorcycle to the nearest Authorised Royal Enfield Service Centre to have the brake system inspected.
The ABS lamp should turn off once the speed passes 5 km/h, and it lights up again when the ABS has a malfunction.

watchouts.text: Failing to follow the ABS cautions can cause an accident, serious injuries or loss of life.

disclaimers.text: The manual gives no time frame for waiting before the brake system is inspected.
